title: Presentation at Technical Committee on Service Computing (SC)｜Social Intelligence Laboratory, Ritsumeikan University
abstractContent: Mr. Oi gave a research presentation on Service Clustering by Heterogeneous Networks and Graph Embedding at the Service Computing Study Group and received the Young Researcher Award.

presentations.speaker: Oi Narifumi
presentations.title: Service clustering with heterogeneous networks
presentations.abstract: We construct two different networks: a network representing the collaboration relationships between services, and a network representing the usage relationships between services and users. We use graph embedding to achieve service embedding. To validate the effectiveness of our proposed method, we apply it to real data from web services and conduct clustering experiments. As a result, we achieve a 6.6% improvement in accuracy compared to existing methods.
